An incredible miracle unfolds as young William's mother shares the harrowing details of his six-day survival in Victorian bushland.
Evidence: Family statements, Search & Rescue reports, media interviews
#Australia #Survival 🌐

William's mother Elizabeth shares the emotional and miraculous details of her son surviving six lost days in the Victorian bush.
